// diagnostic

E1014

`{name}` fills role `{role}`, which `{first}` already fills

What

`{name}` fills role `{role}`, which `{first}` already fills

Why

The compiler runs the one Core function that fills a role, so each role is filled exactly once.

Fix

Remove `#Builtin.Role(.{role})` from one of the two functions.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1014: Tests/UI/CoreRoleDuplicate/stderr.

Error [jet.DuplicateCoreRole]: `duplicate_abs_f32` fills role `AbsF32`, which `abs_f32` already fills
  --> <corelib>/Core/Math/Stats.jet:6:24
    |
  6 | #Builtin.Role(.AbsF32) duplicate_abs_f32: fn(n: F32) -> F32 { n }
    |                        ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: The compiler runs the one Core function that fills a role, so each role is filled exactly once.
 Fix: Remove `#Builtin.Role(.AbsF32)` from one of the two functions.
